description: Two genetically distinct sub-clones share one culture and one carrying capacity. The clone with higher maintenance and repair keeps dividing after the other senesces and takes over the culture (docs/MODEL.md 2.2). A mechanism illustration, not a calibrated claim. Precomputed example run of the Telomere Lab model with fixed seeds -- not patient data and not a prediction. Illustrative model behaviour only; see the Scientific scope page.

biological_age.formula_note: age_index = 100 * (1 - mean(normalized_survival, normalized_telomere_reserve, 1 - senescent_fraction)), computed at every recorded cycle from this simulation's own terminal-metric quantities (docs/MODEL.md §4); an extinct culture saturates at 100. This is an illustrative composite convenience number, not a validated biomarker or a measurement of biological age -- see docs/SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE.md.

title: Sub-clone competition (resilient vs fragile)
